name: Canvas Translate AI
description: Optional AI-assisted machine translation for Canvas Translate, via the Drupal AI module.
project_description: Optional submodule of Canvas Translate that adds AI-assisted machine translation via the contrib AI module. It exposes JSON endpoints that translate the strings the Canvas Translate editor already holds and returns suggested target values, which the editor drops into the pending translation draft for human review. It prefers the AI module's dedicated Translate Text operation and falls back to a Chat provider with a translation prompt, so sites with only a chat provider still get machine translation. It never loads or writes Canvas content itself.
